_doc: Docker Sandboxes ('Docker sandbox cloud') provider for Prospect Studio. Staged 2026-11-03; NOT applied. Desktop has no sbx CLI yet; legacy `docker sandbox` is removed in Docker 29.9.2.

resources.note: Desktop ~1.7 GB free RAM, WSL cap 6 GB: one sandbox at a time.

rules.tierRouting: Tier 2 only; routing only moves up and is logged
rules.killSwitch: honor Convex kill switch before every launch (currently paused)
rules.secrets: env var names only; injected by sbx secret store, never in prompts or logs
